import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 7100;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int from, to;
            long flow, cap;
            Edge(int from, int to, long flow, long cap) {
                this.from = from;
                this.to = to;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        int S, T;
        ArrayList<Edge> E = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer>[] G = new ArrayList[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] level = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] mark = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] ptr = new int[MAX_SIZE];

        Dinic() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
                G[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            E.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            G[u].add(E.size() - 2);
            G[v].add(E.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(mark, 0);
            Arrays.fill(level, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            mark[S] = 1;
            level[S] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int idx : G[v]) {
                    Edge e = E.get(idx);
                    if (mark[e.to] == 0 && e.cap > e.flow) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                        mark[e.to] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return mark[T] == 1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long flow) {
            if (v == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            long pushed = 0;
            for (int i = ptr[v]; i < G[v].size(); i++) {
                Edge e = E.get(G[v].get(i));
                if (level[v] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                    long minf = Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow);
                    long add = dfs(e.to, minf);
                    if (add > 0) {
                        e.flow += add;
                        E.get(G[v].get(i) ^ 1).flow -= add;
                        pushed += add;
                        flow -= add;
                        if (flow == 0) {
                            ptr[v] = i;
                            return pushed;
                        }
                    }
                }
                ptr[v] = i + 1;
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                flow += dfs(S, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int idx(int l, int x, int y, int n) {
        return l * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;
    }

    static int[][] bfs(int sx, int sy, char[][] g1, int n) {
        int[][] dist = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], 111);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int cx = p[0], cy = p[1];
            if (seen[cx][cy]) continue;
            seen[cx][cy] = true;
            dist[cx][cy] = p[2];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[d];
                int ny = cy + dy[d];
                if (nx < 1 || nx > n || ny < 1 || ny > n || seen[nx][ny] || g1[nx][ny] == 'Y') continue;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, p[2] + 1});
            }
        }
        return dist;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        char[][] g1 = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        char[][] g2 = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        Dinic mf = new Dinic();
        mf.S = 0;
        mf.T = MAX_SIZE - 2;

        int sx = 0, sy = 0;
        outer:
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    break outer;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] tgt = new int[n * n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n * n; i++) {
            tgt[i] = MAX_SIZE - 3 - (n * n - i);
        }

        int[][] dist = bfs(sx, sy, g1, n);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] >= '0' && g1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(mf.S, idx(0, i, j, n), g1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (g2[i][j] >= '0' && g2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(tgt[idx(0, i, j, n)], mf.T, g2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                mf.addEdge(idx(0, i, j, n), tgt[idx(0, i, j, n)], INF);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (g1[j][k] == 'Y' || g1[j][k] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
                        int tx = dx[l] + j;
                        int ty = dy[l] + k;
                        if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && g1[tx][ty] != 'Y' && g1[tx][ty] != 'Z') {
                            if (dist[j][k] >= i && dist[tx][ty] >= i) {
                                mf.addEdge(idx(i - 1, tx, ty, n), idx(i, j, k, n), INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    mf.addEdge(idx(i, j, k, n), tgt[idx(0, j, k, n)], INF);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
